sections.title: 4. Evaluation for Editing Systems + 5.1 Implementation Details
Limitations / failure boundary (distributed in Appendix G)

abstract_sentences.text: With the recent fast development of generative models, instruction-based image editing has shown great potential in generating high-quality images.

evidence.anchor: instruction-based image editing has shown great potential

abstract_sentences.text: However, the quality of editing highly depends on carefully designed instructions, placing the burden of task decomposition and sequencing entirely on the user.

evidence.anchor: placing the burden of task decomposition and sequencing entirely on the user

abstract_sentences.text: To achieve autonomous image editing, we present PhotoAgent, a system that advances image editing through explicit aesthetic planning.

evidence.anchor: advances image editing through explicit aesthetic planning

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, PhotoAgent formulates autonomous image editing as a long-horizon decision-making problem.

evidence.anchor: formulates autonomous image editing as a long-horizon decision-making problem

abstract_sentences.text: It reasons over user aesthetic intent, plans multi-step editing actions via tree search, and iteratively refines results through closed-loop execution with memory and visual feedback, without requiring step-by-step user prompts.

evidence.anchor: plans multi-step editing actions via tree search

abstract_sentences.text: To support reliable evaluation in real-world scenarios, we introduce UGC-Edit, an aesthetic evaluation benchmark consisting of 7,000 photos and a learned aesthetic reward model.

evidence.anchor: UGC-Edit, an aesthetic evaluation benchmark consisting of 7,000 photos

abstract_sentences.text: We also construct a test set containing 1,017 photos to systematically assess autonomous photo editing performance.

evidence.anchor: test set containing 1,017 photos

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhotoAgent consistently improves both instruction adherence and visual quality compared with baseline methods.

evidence.anchor: consistently improves both instruction adherence and visual quality

experimental_design.name: UGC-Edit data construction
experimental_design.description: 约 7,000 authentic UGC photos 来自 LAION Aesthetic 与 RealQA；VLM 先分类，人工核验后保留 UGC characteristics，并把 aesthetic scores 统一到 1–5。

evidence.anchor: two-stage filtering process
images are then filtered by human annotators

experimental_design.name: UGC reward model training
experimental_design.description: Qwen2.5-VL 初始化，使用 GRPO 从 image groups 的 relative rankings 学习 fine-grained aesthetic scores，作为 evaluation framework 的一个组件。

evidence.anchor: optimized using Group Relative Policy Optimization
reward model is trained via GRPO

experimental_design.name: End-to-end 1,017-photo benchmark
experimental_design.description: 独立 benchmark 包含 1,017 张真实用户照片，覆盖 portrait、landscape/nature、urban/architecture、food、everyday objects 和 low-light/night；Appendix E 补充多来源。

evidence.anchor: benchmark consisting of 1,017 real-world photographs

experimental_design.name: Baseline grouping and ambiguous instruction
experimental_design.description: Non-agent baseline 为 InstructPix2Pix、SDXL+Prompt、Flux.1 Kontext；agent baseline 为 HuggingGPT、ReAct open-loop、ReAct closed-loop；非 agent 使用 “make this image better”。

experimental_design.name: Metric panel
experimental_design.description: CLIP Similarity 测 semantic/content alignment；ImageReward、BRISQUE、Laion-Reward 和 UGC Score 测 non-reference quality 或 aesthetic preference。

experimental_design.name: User study
experimental_design.description: 20 participants、27 real-world editing scenarios、540 votes；按 visual quality 和 willingness to share 选择最佳结果。

experimental_design.description: 默认 planner depth=3、每轮最多 20 simulations、3 editing iterations；Appendix F 报告 runtime breakdown、budget sweep、backend replacement 和 model acceleration。

claim_closure.claim: PhotoAgent 将 precise sequential instruction burden 转为 autonomous editing。
claim_closure.origin: Abstract 和 §1 的问题/贡献；目标是减少用户分解、选工具和重复交互。
claim_closure.method_response: Perceiver、memory、MCTS、heterogeneous Executor、Evaluator 和 rollback 组成 perceive–plan–execute–evaluate 闭环。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Fig. 1/2、Fig. 4–6 以及 Table 1/2 给出系统流程和结果证据。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 回收 sequential decision-making、四组件和 coordinated interaction。

evidence.anchor: perceive–plan–execute–evaluate cycle
reframes photo editing as a sequential decision-making process

claim_closure.claim: long-horizon MCTS 能避免短视决策。
claim_closure.method_response: UCT selection、leaf expansion、reduced-resolution simulation、backpropagation、top-K execution 和 replanning 对应该机制。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 6 支持 simulation budget 影响；depth=1 与 evaluator removal 只有文字性 ablation。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 将其概括为 MCTS-driven exploration strategy。

evidence.anchor: evaluating their long-term consequences before execution
Impact of simulation budget

claim_closure.claim: UGC-specific evaluator 更贴近用户审美。
claim_closure.origin: §1/§4 的评价缺口与 UGC-Edit/reward-model 贡献。
claim_closure.method_response: UGC-Edit 经过 VLM filtering 与人工核验，Qwen2.5-VL + GRPO reward model 纳入 evaluator ensemble。
claim_closure.evidence_response: PARA correlation 和 Table 1 UGC Score 提供 alignment evidence，但 GPT-4o UGC Score 更高，且选择与评估存在可能耦合。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 只回收 UGC-Edit 作为 framework 支撑。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文的单一主线是：把用户手工分解和排序 vague aesthetic intent 重构为 Perceiver 生成语义原子动作、MCTS 在低分辨率环境探索多步轨迹、top-K 由异质 Executor 在真实分辨率执行、Evaluator 选择/回滚、memory/replanning 继续下一轮的闭环。增量集中在规划与评价接口的协同，底层编辑器不是创新焦点。〔pp. 1–5、9，interpretation，"closed-loop framework"；"coordinated interaction of multiple modules"〕
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留四组件定义、MCTS 四阶段、top-K/full-resolution execution、score comparison/rollback、UGC-Edit 与 1,017-photo benchmark、baseline/metric protocol、Table 1/2、Fig. 4–6 和 termination condition，使读者能判断动作选择与主要结果。〔pp. 4–8，explicit，"Otherwise, the system reverts"；"42.0%"〕
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A/B/F 将 sim-to-real、reward generalization、runtime/budget trade-off 移出正文，C/D/E/G 补 Algorithm 1、权重、数据 provenance、额外案例和 failures；正文主线可读，但 failure、470s latency、fairness protocol 和 Appendix H 缺失无法由正文独立核验。〔pp. 9、12、19–21，layout_observation，"Total ∼470"；"Appendix"〕
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效的模式是 Figure 1 先用 people-loop 对照建立需求，Figure 2 固定闭环数据流，Figure 3 说明 UGC reward/data interface，再用 Table 1/2 把机制连接到 multi-metric 与 human preference。〔pp. 2、4、6–8，interpretation，"Detailed loop"；"Pipeline"〕
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大缺口是 broad state-of-the-art/consistently improves 叙述与有限 baseline、无 uncertainty、ImageReward/UGC 非最高、文字性 ablation、selection–measurement coupling 之间的识别差距；p4 还存在 Appendix H 交叉引用错误。〔pp. 1、4、7–8、12–21，interpretation/layout_observation，"state-of-the-art"；"See Appendix H"〕
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对规划—执行—评价系统，正文先用一张图固定 state、candidate action、search、real execution 和 accept/rollback 接口，再让每个主张绑定独立 metric 或 human judgment，最后用组件和 budget ablation 拆解收益。〔pp. 4–8，interpretation，"perceive–plan–execute–evaluate"〕
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则要求 action space、evaluator、backend、prompt、seed 和 human protocol 可被明确记录，且输出选择不复用同一指标造成测量耦合；跨域或底层模型细节未公开时，闭环图不能替代独立评价与可复现性。〔pp. 5–7、12–21，interpretation，"highest candidate score"；"20 participants"〕
